setup.command:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 3
fi
head_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')
worktree_hash=$(
    git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
status_hash=$(
    git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
index_hash=$(
    git ls-files --stage -z |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
printf 'head_commit	%s
' "$head_commit"
printf 'worktree_hash	%s
' "$worktree_hash"
printf 'status_hash	%s
' "$status_hash"
printf 'index_hash	%s
' "$index_hash"

        os.Exit(1)
    }
    fmt.Println("Successfully modified util.go")
}

func findFunc(lines []string, funcName string) (start, end int) {
    for i, line := range lines {
        if strings.Contains(line, funcName+"(") && strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "func") {
            start = i
            // find end: next line that starts with "func " at same level
            for j := i + 1; j < len(lines); j++ {
                if strings.HasPrefix(lines[j], "func ") {
                    end = j
                    return
                }
                // Also if line is at same indentation (col 0) and not empty and doesn't start with /* or //, it's next func
                // But safer to rely on 'func '
            }
            end = len(lines) // if not found, go to end
        }
    }
    return
}
